tucson-chinese-school-tucson.short_description_en: Tucson Chinese School Tucson Chinese School (TCS) was founded in 1950 over 63 years ago.
tucson-chinese-school-tucson.description_en: Tucson Chinese School Tucson Chinese School (TCS) was founded in 1950 over 63 years ago. After generations of hard work, TCS has become a major force in Southern Arizona Chinese education. The quality of teaching in TCS has improved quickly and has become the Southern Arizona Chinese education leader. TCS moved to the Tucson Chinese Cultural Center in 2005. This move allowed TCS to develop the best facilities, the strongest faculty, the highest quality of teaching, and the most complete grades in the Tucson area. Join us this semester to start or continue your language-learning journey. You may sign-up at any point throughout the year. Classes are offered for all levels. To sign up, fill out the registration form linked at the buttons below and send to info@tucsonchinese.org, or bring to the center during regular hours. Additional Documents: Emergency Information Form Tucson Chinese School Curriculum Tucson Chinese School offers classes form pre-school to adult level. Our educational programs, organized into two semesters per year, emphasize character recognition, reading and writing skills, as well as listening and conversation. Speech, writing and spelling contests are all organized throughout the year.
